name: Rina's Tailoring
story: Rina runs a one-woman tailoring stall supporting her family of four after her husband's job loss during the pandemic.

name: Anna's Snack Corner
story: A family-run snack stall near the station that funds two children's school fees entirely from daily sales.

name: Suresh Repairs
story: Suresh fixes household electronics and bicycles, offering free repairs one day a week to families who can't pay.

name: Lakshmi Handicrafts
story: A women's self-help group of eight artisans weaving jute bags and home decor, reinvesting profits into a shared savings fund.

name: Fatima's Grocery
story: A small kirana store that extends informal credit to daily-wage families during tough months.

name: Deepak's Bicycle Rickshaw Co-op
story: A twelve-member co-op of cycle-rickshaw pullers who pooled savings to buy their own vehicles and cut out predatory rentals.

name: Meena's Tiffin Service
story: Meena cooks and delivers affordable home-style tiffins, employing three other women from her building.

name: Iqbal's Cobbler Stand
story: Iqbal has repaired footwear at the same street corner for twenty years, now training his teenage son in the trade.
